method.accepted: only when the candidate scored strictly better than the baseline
method.frames: voiced frames whose reference RMS is at least 2000; a log-domain measure is meaningless on near-silence
method.independence: each frame was searched against the unoptimised phrase, so gains were measured one frame at a time and are not additive by construction
method.renderer: a cycle-accurate emulation of the TMS52xx speech core, driven with the same clock and tail for every candidate
method.scored_span: the corrected frame and the one after it
method.scoring: each candidate rendered and compared against the same speech through TMS5200 tables; mel-cepstral distortion over the frame and its successor
method.search: coordinate descent, +/-1 around each nearest-mapped K index, 2 passes
